text: Earlier power tests planted clean book English. Sanborn writes with X stops, misspellings and odd phrasing; here the planted messages are written that way.
The three frozen searches behind F1.1, F1.2 and F1.3's sampled closes, run unchanged on 36 planted texts and each text's own scrambled copies; found by letter statistics, and separately by the judge.

Letter statistics find 10 of 12 at length 23 and 12 of 12 for 0125, above their bars; 9 of 12 at length 13, one plant under its bar of 4 in 5, so F1.2's close at 13 goes back to open. The judge finds 1 and 0 of 12 in the climbed readings.
